range.sql: SELECT LEAST((SELECT MIN(startdate)::date FROM production.workorder), (SELECT MIN(actualstartdate)::date FROM production.workorderrouting)) AS "minDate", GREATEST((SELECT MAX(enddate)::date FROM production.workorder), (SELECT MAX(actualenddate)::date FROM production.workorderrouting)) AS "maxDate"

summary.sql: WITH period AS (SELECT %s::date AS from_date, (%s::date + INTERVAL '1 day') AS to_exclusive) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM production.workorder wo, period p WHERE wo.startdate >= p.from_date AND wo.startdate < p.to_exclusive) AS "startedWorkOrderCount", (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM production.workorder wo, period p WHERE wo.enddate >= p.from_date AND wo.enddate < p.to_exclusive) AS "completedWorkOrderCount", (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM production.workorderrouting wor, period p WHERE wor.actualstartdate >= p.from_date AND wor.actualstartdate < p.to_exclusive) AS "operationCount", (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM production.workorder wo, period p WHERE wo.enddate >= p.from_date AND wo.enddate < p.to_exclusive AND wo.scrappedqty > 0) AS "scrappedWorkOrderCount", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(wo.scrappedqty), 0)::int FROM production.workorder wo, period p WHERE wo.enddate >= p.from_date AND wo.enddate < p.to_exclusive AND wo.scrappedqty > 0) AS "scrappedQty"

trend.sql: WITH period AS (SELECT %s::date AS from_date, %s::date AS to_date), buckets AS (SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('{bucket}', from_date), date_trunc('{bucket}', to_date), INTERVAL '1 {bucket}')::date AS bucket FROM period), started AS (SELECT date_trunc('{bucket}', wo.startdate)::date AS bucket, COUNT(*)::int AS value FROM production.workorder wo, period p WHERE wo.startdate >= p.from_date AND wo.startdate < p.to_date + INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY 1), completed AS (SELECT date_trunc('{bucket}', wo.enddate)::date AS bucket, COUNT(*)::int AS value, COALESCE(SUM(wo.scrappedqty) FILTER (WHERE wo.scrappedqty > 0), 0)::int AS scrapped FROM production.workorder wo, period p WHERE wo.enddate >= p.from_date AND wo.enddate < p.to_date + INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY 1) SELECT b.bucket AS date, COALESCE(s.value, 0)::int AS "startedWorkOrderCount", COALESCE(c.value, 0)::int AS "completedWorkOrderCount", COALESCE(c.scrapped, 0)::int AS "scrappedQty" FROM buckets b LEFT JOIN started s USING (bucket) LEFT JOIN completed c USING (bucket) ORDER BY b.bucket

locations.sql: WITH period AS (SELECT %s::date AS from_date, (%s::date + INTERVAL '1 day') AS to_exclusive) SELECT l.locationid AS "locationId", l.name AS "locationName", COUNT(*)::int AS "operationCount", COUNT(DISTINCT wor.workorderid)::int AS "workOrderCount" FROM production.workorderrouting wor JOIN production.location l ON l.locationid = wor.locationid CROSS JOIN period p WHERE wor.actualstartdate >= p.from_date AND wor.actualstartdate < p.to_exclusive GROUP BY l.locationid, l.name ORDER BY "operationCount" DESC, "locationId" ASC LIMIT 7
